preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L <= R <= 1000000000 for L, R in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the integers L and R are between 1 and 1000000000, with L <= R.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output[i], int) and 0 <= output[i] < 1000000007 for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is an integer between 0 and 1000000006.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == sum(n * len(str(n)) for n in range(L, R + 1)) % 1000000007 for i, (L, R) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is the sum of the goodness of all integers from L to R, inclusive, modulo 1000000007.
